summary: Tested the Help Center end to end. Backend (pytest, 10/10 pass): the public GET /api/help/faqs returns 9 topics and 56 FAQs, sorted by position with no _id. Admin can create, edit, reorder, hide and delete FAQs; customers and guests get 401/403; the admin list is sorted by topic then position. Restarting the backend did not re-seed (still 56). Frontend: /help works. It has the heading, live search ('deposit' gives 4 results in 3 topics; nonsense shows the no-results message), 9 topic tiles that filter and unfilter (Real estate shows 7), expanding Q&As, the four fix buttons going to the right pages, Ask Lumi opening the chat panel, and Contact support going to /contact. The Help link shows in the desktop menu for guest, customer, provider and admin, and in the footer. My orders goes to /orders. Settings has the Help link. At 390px the mobile bottom bar has 5 tabs, labels fit without overflow, and the Help tab works logged in and logged out. In Admin → Content, Help FAQs lists items; I created an FAQ in the UI (it showed first under Payments on /help), edited it to inactive with position 999 (gone from /help), then deleted it. Lumi restyle: the open button is a pill, the panel is rounded (24px), and a live chat reply came back with guide-link chips (/rentals, /rentals/host).

ui_bugs.issue: The desktop menu container <nav> uses data-testid={`nav-${roleForNav}`}, which for a customer becomes 'nav-customer', the same testid as the 'My orders' link. A selector for nav-customer matches 2 elements, and .first() hits the container instead of the link. The same clash can happen for nav-provider and nav-admin. Suggest renaming the container to nav-links-${role}.

issues: Has only the heading; a short helper line would read better
Column header still says 'PRICE STATUS' for FAQs
Count label reads '1 help faqs' (plural is wrong)
The 'Want a guide?' prompt pops up on /help too, which is redundant next to the in-page Ask Lumi button

action_items: Optional: rename the NavBar container testid so it no longer clashes with the nav-customer link
Optional: suppress the auto 'Want a guide?' prompt on /help; fix the FAQ column header and the plural count label in the admin list
critical_code_review_comments: Seeded positions are topic_index*100+i, but auto-position for a new FAQ in an empty topic becomes 1. That is fine because the UI groups by topic, but the global sort in /api/help/faqs mixes topics. Sorting by (topic order, position) would be clearer.
faq create: if the admin form sends is_active as '' it becomes None, and setdefault keeps None. The public filter uses $ne False, so the FAQ is still visible; this is harmless but inconsistent.
Help.jsx silently swallows the fetch error (catch(() => {})): there is no loading or error state, so if the API fails users see only the tiles and fixes, with no message.
seed_data_creation: None kept. All TEST_ FAQs were cleaned up; there are still 56 FAQs.
